performance.verdict: CPL win is real, but Google waste and 6 overdue SOW milestones threaten durability.

findings.text: 6 SOW milestones overdue since July–Sept 2026: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting, and Shoot 1 — all unresolved 3+ months past due.
CPL dropped 39.81% week-over-week to ~$101.77 (28-day) driven entirely by Meta's 37 leads on $1,831.74; Google delivered only 2 conversions on $1,933.68 — a $966/lead rate.
3-day lead signal (Oct 28–30): 1+2+1=4 leads vs prior 3 days (Oct 25–27): 3+0+2=5 leads — flat trending; CPL efficiency gain is a 7d artifact, not a fresh acceleration.
GHL shows 105 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and $0 pipeline value — 37 ad leads are not converting to signed cases, indicating an intake/CRM leak.
GBP actions collapsed 72.92% week-over-week; last 3 series days show 0 GBP actions (Oct 28–30), while paid traffic held — organic local visibility is deteriorating independently.

suggestions.text: Shift $15/day from Google Search to Meta; Google is at $966/lead vs Meta's ~$49/lead over 28 days.
suggestions.monday_update: Move $15/day of daily budget from the Google 'Leads - Search Campaign' to Meta, citing Google's 2 conversions on $1,933.68 (28 days) versus Meta's 37 leads on $1,831.74. This is a ≤20% shift and does not double any budget. Success check: Meta CPL stays below $120 and Google lead count does not recover within 7 days — review by 2026-11-07.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 105 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — ops fix needed before more leads are lost.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 105 opportunities created with 0 appointments booked and 0 cases won over 28 days, meaning every lead entering the pipeline is stalling. Nacer/Ops must audit the booking flow, routing rules, and speed-to-lead configuration (SOW target: first contact under 5 min). Success check: at least 5 appointments appear in GHL within 7 days of the fix — confirm by 2026-11-07.

suggestions.text: Watch 3-day lead trend: 4 leads (Oct 28–30) vs 5 prior — no acceleration yet; do not scale Meta until signal confirms.
suggestions.monday_update: The last 3-day window (Oct 28–30) produced 4 leads vs 5 in the prior window, meaning the 7-day CPL improvement has not yet compounded into fresh volume growth. Hold any further Meta scale until the next 3-day read shows a clear uptick. Re-check on 2026-11-03 — if leads per 3-day window exceed 6, escalate to a scale suggestion.
